title: Ghost hunting tours return to downtown Lompoc | About Town
excerpt: Equipped with EMF meters, spirit boxes, and a healthy mix of curiosity and courage, residents can explore downtown Lompoc’s haunted side each weekend through October.
content:
Equipped with EMF meters, spirit boxes, and a healthy mix of curiosity and courage, residents can explore downtown Lompoc’s haunted side each weekend through October.

The Lompoc Ghost Hunting Tour, part of a wider The Haunt Ghost Tours series also available in Solvang, will lead guests to some of the city’s most legendary sites of paranormal activity — including the old mortuary (today's Chamber of Commerce), the Carnegie Library (now the Lompoc Museum), the historic Lilley Building and the Lompoc Theatre.

Tour guides will share eerie tales drawn from historical newspapers and personal interviews with longtime residents. 

The 1.25-hour tour is designed for ages 12 and up and is fully outdoors and described as PG-13, with no jump scares — just storytelling, history, and hands-on ghost hunting. Each participant leaves with a “Haunt” sticker and stories to tell.

Tours begin at 7 p.m.

Tickets and waitlist information are available at thehauntghosttours.com/tours/lompoc-ghosts/.

Old Town Trick-or-Treat returns, business sought

Halloween fun returns to Old Town Lompoc on Saturday, Oct. 24, from 12–3 p.m., featuring for treats, games, music, costumes, and "plenty of spooky fun for the whole family," the Lompoc Chamber of Commerce announced.

Attendees are invited to come dressed in their favorite costumes and to collect treats from participating local businesses along the Old Town route.

Local businesses that would like to participate and hand out treats can email chamber@lompoc.com to be added to the list.

More details about the event are forthcoming.

Solvang pumpkin patch now open 

The Solvang Farmer Pumpkin Patch is open daily from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. through Oct. 31 at 1035 Alamo Pintado Road, Solvang. The patch features more than 50 varieties of pumpkins, a 14-acre corn maze, kids maze, scavenger hunt, fresh popcorn and kettle corn.

Solvang pumpkin patch adds nighttime maze

The Solvang Farmer Pumpkin Patch will host its special Night Maze on Oct. 23-24 and Oct. 30-31, beginning at 5:30 p.m. with last entry at 9 p.m. The pumpkin patch is at 1035 Alamo Pintado Road in Solvang.
